title: Silver Top years, Depression, and turning down Fate Marable's boat
summary: Russ played with the Silver Top band five or six years; he declined Fate Marable's riverboat to stay near family, then moved to another band.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: So I played with the Silitone office, you know, I was dancing from the Nola band to the Silitone office. Uh-huh. And I played the Silitone office for about six, seven years. About five or six years. And I—not the Silitone, I mean including the whole entire band. Yeah. There was a depression set in. T-Rone was practically the biggest band in the city. And while I was playing on the Pelican, you know it was the Silitone band, Fred Marble was on the board. He came—he came up there, tried to get me to go on the board with him. Uh, at that time, the boat was all right, but I didn't care about traveling, gee. But he used to be there again, go up the line, gee. And I had my family. And I wanted to stay close to my family. Very little traveling at that time. Well, I come to fit Marble Down. So I stayed around there. After a while, I leave the—the Silitone office. I go to A.G. A.G. So I go to the A.G. A.P. room. And I played with the band about two years. So maybe a little less, couldn't be too much less. I was playing with the move card. Well, he had the great—he had—he was one of the greatest, one of the greatest in the city.
